const TF_PROTOCOL_T12_CSS="/* TaskFlow T12 · La X aparece únicamente al completar el protocolo ya iniciado. */\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-locked .v85-routine-modal-head > .window-close,\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-locked .v85-routine-modal-head > [aria-label=\"Cerrar\"]{\n  display:none!important;\n  visibility:hidden!important;\n  pointer-events:none!important;\n}\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-finished .v85-routine-modal-head > .window-close{\n  visibility:visible!important;\n  pointer-events:auto!important;\n}\n";
const TF_PROTOCOL_T12_JS="/* TaskFlow T12 · Bloqueo de salida exclusivamente mientras un protocolo iniciado esté incompleto.\n * No modifica misiones, sus requisitos, su progreso ni sus datos.\n */\n(function(){\n  'use strict';\n  if(window.__tfProtocolLockT12)return;\n  window.__tfProtocolLockT12=true;\n\n  const PANEL='#windowContent';\n  const ROUTINE='.v96-mentalist-scroll,.v97-routine-scroll';\n  const START=/(?:^|\\s)(?:comenzar|iniciar)\\s+(?:el\\s+)?(?:protocolo|rutina)(?:\\s|$)/;\n  let active=null;\n  let pending=false;\n\n  function normal(value){\n    return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g,'')\n      .toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();\n  }\n  function frame(){return document.getElementById('windowContainer')}\n  function panel(){return document.getElementById('windowContent')}\n  function getRoutine(){\n    const f=frame(),p=panel();\n    if(!f||!p||!f.classList.contains('open'))return null;\n    const scroll=p.querySelector(ROUTINE);\n    if(!scroll)return null;\n    const h=p.querySelector('.v85-routine-modal-copy h2');\n    const title=normal(h&&h.textContent)||normal(p.querySelector('.v85-routine-modal-copy')?.textContent);\n    const pill=p.querySelector('.v85-routine-progress-pill');\n    const txt=String(pill&&pill.textContent||'');\n    const m=txt.match(/(\\d+)\\s*\\/\\s*(\\d+)/);\n    let done=m?Number(m[1]):-1;\n    let total=m?Number(m[2]):-1;\n    if(total<=0){\n      // Únicamente como respaldo cuando el núcleo no presenta contador numérico.\n      const mission=scroll.querySelectorAll('.v94-mentalist-step,.v69-routine-item,.v85-sung-item,.v83-legal-item');\n      if(mission.length){total=mission.length;done=Array.from(mission).filter(x=>x.classList.contains('done')||x.classList.contains('completed')||x.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true').length;}\n    }\n    if(total<=0 || done<0)return null;\n    return {f,p,scroll,title,done,total,completed:done>=total};\n  }\n  function sameRoutine(r){\n    return !!(active&&r&&r.title===active.title&&r.total===active.total);\n  }\n  function update(){\n    if(!active)return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(!sameRoutine(r))return;\n    const lock=!r.completed;\n    active.completed=r.completed;\n    // Evitar mutaciones DOM innecesarias y no interferir con las tarjetas.\n    if(r.f.classList.contains('tf-protocol-t12-locked')!==lock)\n      r.f.classList.toggle('tf-protocol-t12-locked',lock);\n    if(r.f.classList.contains('tf-protocol-t12-finished')!==!lock)\n      r.f.classList.toggle('tf-protocol-t12-finished',!lock);\n  }\n  function schedule(){\n    if(pending)return;\n    pending=true;\n    requestAnimationFrame(function(){pending=false;update()});\n  }\n  function locked(){\n    if(!active)return false;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(sameRoutine(r)){\n      if(r.completed){update();return false;}\n      return true;\n    }\n    // Conservar la protección ante una transición accidental mientras el protocolo sigue activo.\n    return !active.completed;\n  }\n  function start(button){\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(!r||!r.p.contains(button))return false;\n    if(!START.test(normal(button.textContent)))return false;\n    active={title:r.title,total:r.total,completed:r.completed};\n    update();\n    return true;\n  }\n  function isExit(target,r){\n    if(!target||!target.closest)return false;\n    if(target.closest('#windowContainer .window-close,#windowContainer [data-close],#windowContainer [aria-label*=\"Cerrar\"],#windowContainer [aria-label*=\"cerrar\"]'))return true;\n    return !!(r&&!r.p.contains(target));\n  }\n  // Evitar cierres lanzados por la aplicación sin pasar por el botón de la X.\n  // Cuando el 100 % se alcanza, se delega intacto al cierre original.\n  try{\n    if(typeof window.closeWindow==='function'&&!window.closeWindow.__tfProtocolGuardT12){\n      const nativeClose=window.closeWindow;\n      const guardedClose=function(){\n        if(locked())return;\n        return nativeClose.apply(this,arguments);\n      };\n      guardedClose.__tfProtocolGuardT12=true;\n      window.closeWindow=guardedClose;\n    }\n  }catch(error){console.warn('TaskFlow: protección de cierre parcial',error)}\n  // El listener en window/captura se ejecuta ANTES de los cierres y navegaciones de otros módulos.\n  window.addEventListener('click',function(event){\n    const target=event.target;\n    const button=target&&target.closest&&target.closest('button,[role=\"button\"]');\n    if(button && start(button))return;\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(target,r)){\n      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },true);\n  window.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const k=event.key;\n    const exitKey=k==='Escape'||k==='BrowserBack'||k==='GoBack'||\n      (k==='Backspace'&&!event.target.closest?.('input,textarea,[contenteditable=\"true\"]'))||\n      (event.altKey&&(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='Left'));\n    if(exitKey){event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();}\n  },true);\n  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(event.target,r)){\n      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },true);\n  document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(event.target,r)){\n      if(event.cancelable)event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },{capture:true,passive:false});\n  // El navegador puede autorizar o ignorar el diálogo al abandonar la página.\n  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    event.preventDefault();event.returnValue='';\n  });\n  const p=panel();\n  if(p){\n    const observer=new MutationObserver(schedule);\n    observer.observe(p,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});\n  }\n  const f=frame();\n  if(f){\n    const obs=new MutationObserver(schedule);\n    obs.observe(f,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});\n  }\n  // No se guarda nada en localStorage ni se modifica el estado de las misiones.\n  window.__tfProtocolLockT12Inspect=function(){\n const TF_CLOCK_T13_JS="/* T36 · Un solo reloj y progreso del mismo ciclo diario, 01:00 de Guatemala. */\n(function(){\n'use strict';\nif(window.__tfSmoothDailyCountdownT18)return;\nwindow.__tfSmoothDailyCountdownT18=true;\nconst ELEMENT='resetCountdownTime',DAY=86400000,GT_OFFSET=21600000;\nlet timer=0,displayed=null,lastText='',active=true,lastFill='';\nconst pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');\nfunction cycle(now){\n const g=new Date(now-GT_OFFSET);\n let reset=Date.UTC(g.getUTCFullYear(),g.getUTCMonth(),g.getUTCDate(),7,0,0);\n if(now>=reset)reset+=DAY;\n const elapsed=Math.max(0,Math.min(DAY,now-(reset-DAY)));\n return {remaining:Math.max(0,Math.ceil((reset-now)/1000)),progress:elapsed/DAY,reset};\n}\nfunction paint(seconds,progress){\n const el=document.getElementById(ELEMENT);if(!el)return;\n const text=pad(Math.floor(seconds/3600))+':'+pad(Math.floor(seconds%3600/60))+':'+pad(seconds%60);\n if(text!==lastText||el.textContent!==text){el.textContent=text;lastText=text}\n const fill=(progress*100).toFixed(7)+'%';\n if(fill!==lastFill||el.style.getPropertyValue('--tf36-cycle-fill')!==fill){el.style.setProperty('--tf36-cycle-fill',fill);lastFill=fill}\n}\nfunction tick(){\n timer=0;if(document.hidden||!active)return;\n const now=Date.now(),state=cycle(now),target=state.remaining;\n if(displayed===null||target>displayed)displayed=target;else if(displayed>target)displayed-=1;\n paint(displayed,state.progress);\n timer=setTimeout(tick,displayed>target?110:Math.max(120,1010-(Date.now()%1000)));\n}\nfunction restart(){if(timer)clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;if(document.hidden){active=false;return}active=true;displayed=null;tick()}\ndocument.addEventListener('visibilitychange',restart,{passive:true});\nwindow.addEventListener('pageshow',restart,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('focus',restart,{passive:true});\nif(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',restart,{once:true});else restart();\n})();\n";

const TF_T17_JS="/* TaskFlow T17 · Etapas de Mentalista y retención de desplazamiento Sung, sin alterar sus misiones. */\n(function(){\n'use strict';\nif(window.__tfRoutineLayoutT17)return;\nwindow.__tfRoutineLayoutT17=true;\nconst outer=document.getElementById('windowContainer');\nconst panel=document.getElementById('windowContent');\nif(!outer||!panel)return;\nlet scheduled=false;\nfunction schedule(){if(scheduled)return;scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(function(){scheduled=false;update()})}\nfunction progress(){\n const p=panel.querySelector('.v85-routine-modal-head .v85-routine-progress-pill');\n const m=String(p&&p.textContent||'').match(/(\\d+)\\s*\\/\\s*(\\d+)/);\n return m?{done:Math.max(0,Number(m[1])),total:Number(m[2])}:null;\n}\n/* T96: suprimir la escala redundante; el progreso válido pertenece a tfm-legal-progress. */\nfunction updateMental(){\n if(!outer.classList.contains('mentalist-modal'))return;\n const summary=panel.querySelector('.v96-mentalist-scroll .tfm-summary');\n if(!summary)return;\n summary.querySelectorAll('.tf17-mental-steps').forEach(el=>el.remove());\n const extra=summary.querySelector(':scope > .tfm-meter');\n if(extra)extra.remove();\n}\nfunction update(){\n if(!outer.classList.contains('open'))return;\n if(panel.querySelector('.v96-mentalist-scroll'))updateMental();\n}\n// Sung reconstruye las tarjetas al marcar: conservar el lugar del usuario en la lista.\nwindow.addEventListener('click',function(ev){\n const el=ev.target&&ev.target.closest&&ev.target.closest('#windowContent.tf15-sung .v85-sung-list .v32-check');\n if(!el)return;\n const list=panel.querySelector('.v85-sung-list.v97-routine-scroll');\n if(!list)return;\n const oldTop=list.scrollTop;\n requestAnimationFrame(function(){\n  const current=panel.querySelector('.v85-sung-list.v97-routine-scroll');\n  if(current&&current.scrollTop<oldTop-4)current.scrollTop=oldTop;\n });\n},true);\nconst mo=new MutationObserver(function(records){\n if(!outer.classList.contains('open'))return;\n for(const r of records){\n  if(r.type==='childList'){\n   const nodes=[...r.addedNodes];\n   if(nodes.some(n=>n.nodeType===1 && (n.matches?.('.tfm-summary,.v96-mentalist-scroll,.v85-routine-modal-head')||n.querySelector?.('.tfm-summary')))){schedule();return}\n  }\n  if(r.type==='characterData'&&r.target.parentElement?.closest('.v85-routine-progress-pill')){schedule();return}\n }\n});\nmo.observe(panel,{subtree:false,childList:true,characterData:false});\nconst classWatcher=new MutationObserver(schedule);\nclassWatcher.observe(outer,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});\ndocument.addEventListener('click',function(e){\n const TF_AUDIO_T16_JS="/* T16: la comprobación de música guardada se realiza sin pantallazos. */\n(function(){\n'use strict';\nif(window.__tfSilentAudioVerifyT16)return;\nwindow.__tfSilentAudioVerifyT16=true;\nconst ID='tfAudioGateV13057';\nfunction watchGate(gate){\n  if(gate.dataset.tfSilentWatchT16==='1')return;\n  gate.dataset.tfSilentWatchT16='1';\n  const status=gate.querySelector('.tf-audio-gate-status');\n  if(!status)return;\n  const assess=()=>{\n    const label=String(status.textContent||'').trim();\n    const realDownload=/^Descargando música\\s+\\d+\\s+de\\s+\\d+/i.test(label);\n    const needsAction=/^La música debe quedar descargada completamente/i.test(label);\n    // No mostrar un diálogo mientras solo se verifica un paquete ya almacenado.\n    gate.classList.toggle('tf-audio-real-download-t16',realDownload||needsAction);\n  };\n  const statusObserver=new MutationObserver(assess);\n  statusObserver.observe(status,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});\n  assess();\n}\nfunction ready(){\n  const body=document.body;if(!body)return;\n  const found=document.getElementById(ID);\n  if(found){watchGate(found);return;}\n  const observer=new MutationObserver(records=>{\n    for(const record of records){\n      for(const node of record.addedNodes){\n        if(node.nodeType!==1)continue;\n        const gate=node.id===ID?node:node.querySelector?.('#'+ID);\n        if(gate){observer.disconnect();watchGate(gate);return;}\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  observer.observe(body,{childList:true});\n}\nif(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',ready,{once:true});\nelse ready();\n})();\n";
const TF_AUDIO_T16_CSS="/* T16: ocultar solamente la verificación ya guardada. */\n#tfAudioGateV13057.open:not(.tf-audio-real-download-t16){display:none!important}\n#tfAudioGateV13057.open.tf-audio-real-download-t16{display:flex!important}\n/* Mantener estable el ancho de los dígitos y el desplazamiento nativo. */\n#resetCountdownTime{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums!important;font-feature-settings:'tnum' 1!important}\n";
